capabilities: Read saved path fields from Citations or Citation Extended settings
Flag edge spaces, leading slashes, and hidden Markdown suffixes
Sample the target file for BibTeX or CSL JSON content
List up to eight same-folder files with matching base names
Label Windows, UNC, and desktop paths as outside the vault
disambiguation: Not a reference manager or importer; it only reads citation tool settings and reports path faults without changing settings or files.
extras: Free audit only; named reports and batch checks are listed as planned Pro work, and the GitHub Sponsors sign-in adds no features in this release. A What's new tab opens after minor or major updates and can be turned off in settings. README lists untested areas: Linux CI, light themes, physical mobile devices, Windows desktop, symlink escapes, live citation plugin releases, real sponsorship payments, large reference collections. Content reads are skipped above 2 MiB; sample inspection covers up to 4096 characters.
problem: A citation tool stops loading references when its saved bibliography path has a small fault, and Obsidian gives no way to inspect that stored value.

relations.evidence: Citations uses its saved export path and format.
Citation Extended lists entries with an explicit local-file or vault-file source and a supported format.

summary: Read-only auditor that reads Citations or Citation Extended path settings and reports faults in the saved local bibliography path.
